title: an inline-hosted sprint can write source in scoping through a python heredoc; the write hook reads command text only
detail: Observed 2026-11-19 in attempt-scoped-cost (trivial lane, hosted in the operator session): python3 - <<EOF ... Path(...).write_text(...) edited prusik/*.py in worktrees/solo while the phase was scoping (writable: design/.../scope.md, trivial.md, scope-approval.txt). Not blocked; the Write tool was blocked correctly moments later. Drive's _check_tree (fb-1303f39d14a6) catches this class for spawned roles by reading the tree after the spawn; the inline host has no equivalent. Expected: phase writability holds whatever tool writes, e.g. the Stop/advance hook compares the tree against the phase's writable set.
